description: End-to-end service assurance workflow for Telco-as-a-Service (TaaS) connectivity across cloud exchange fabrics, from intent definition and path provisioning to monitoring, incident management, and rollback.

tenant_id.description: Unique identifier for the tenant or enterprise customer

service_id.description: Identifier of the logical connectivity service instance across the cloud exchange

assurance_session_id.description: Identifier for a service assurance session tracking monitoring, tests and incidents for a given service_id

path_id.description: Identifier for a specific provisioned path or segment in the cloud exchange fabric

incident_id.description: Identifier for a detected or reported incident related to service assurance

test_id.description: Identifier for an on-demand or scheduled active test associated with a service or path

change_ticket_id.description: Identifier for a change or rollback operation related to service assurance

endpoint_id.description: Identifier for an endpoint (e.g., customer site, cloud on-ramp, virtual network)

functions.name: define_assurance_intent
functions.description: Define high-level service assurance intent and policies for a tenant's connectivity service across the cloud exchange.

service_id.description: Target service for which assurance intent is being defined

name.description: Human-readable name for the assurance intent

description.description: Detailed description of the assurance objectives

priority_level.description: Assurance priority tier mapped to monitoring and protection behavior

availability_percent.description: Target availability percentage over a defined period

coverage_scope.description: Scope of resources to include in assurance

paths.description: Specific paths or segments to be monitored

delay_minutes.description: Delay after detection before escalating to this level

role.description: Role for this escalation target (e.g., NOC, SRE)

functions.returns: Created/updated assurance intent profile and a new or existing assurance_session_id bound to the service.

functions.name: create_assurance_session
functions.description: Instantiate a service assurance session that binds intent, endpoints, and initial monitoring topology for a given service.

intent_reference.description: Reference to an existing intent or inline overrides

assurance_session_id.description: Existing assurance session to clone or extend

overrides.description: Optional SLA or scope overrides for this session only

time_window.description: Custom monitoring window for this session

functions.returns: New assurance_session_id, discovered or validated paths, and initial monitoring plan for the service.

functions.name: provision_assurance_path
functions.description: Provision or adjust an assurance-enabled path across the cloud exchange fabric with specified SLA class and protection.

path_spec.description: Definition of the path to be provisioned or updated

path_id.description: Existing path_id to modify, omit to create new path

diverse_paths.description: Whether protection paths must be physically diverse

labels.description: Arbitrary labels for identification and grouping

dry_run.description: If true, only validate feasibility and return a plan without applying

functions.returns: Provisioning result including path_id, applied parameters, and feasibility or error details if dry_run or failure.

functions.name: check_path_health
functions.description: Retrieve current and recent health status, SLA compliance, and anomalies for a specific path within an assurance session.

include.description: Optional sections to include in the response

functions.returns: Health summary for the requested path including KPI timeseries, current status, SLA evaluation, active alarms, and detected anomalies.

functions.name: run_active_test
functions.description: Trigger an on-demand or scheduled active test (e.g., ping, traceroute, throughput test) for a path or endpoint to validate performance.

max_runs.description: Maximum number of runs for recurring tests

labels.description: Custom labels to attach to the test

functions.returns: Created test_id, test execution or schedule status, and where applicable an initial result handle for retrieval.

functions.name: get_test_results
functions.description: Retrieve status and detailed results for a previously initiated active test.

pagination.description: Pagination options for large result sets like raw_packets

functions.returns: Test execution status plus requested result sections (latency/jitter stats, hop lists, throughput, raw packet samples, and logs).

functions.name: detect_and_create_incident
functions.description: Evaluate telemetry against intent and create an incident if thresholds are breached or anomalies are detected.

evaluation_scope.description: Scope of telemetry and conditions to evaluate

detection_policy.description: Policy to determine whether to open a new incident

min_duration_violation_seconds.description: Minimum duration of sustained breach to trigger incident

functions.returns: Incident creation result including incident_id if a new incident is opened, or evaluation summary if no incident is created.

functions.name: get_incident_details
functions.description: Retrieve full context for an incident including impact analysis, correlated events, and current status.
functions.returns: Incident object including status, severity, affected services/paths, diagnostic context, and any attached tests or notes.

functions.name: update_incident_state
functions.description: Update the lifecycle state, severity, or annotations of an existing incident.

assigned_group.description: Operations group now responsible for the incident

functions.returns: Updated incident record, including previous and current state summaries.

functions.name: trigger_remediation_action
functions.description: Execute a remediation action such as path re-optimization, bandwidth adjustment, or traffic re-route in response to an incident.

remediation_plan.description: Plan defining the remediation action to take

target_paths.description: Paths to apply remediation to; may be empty for incident default

delta_mbps.description: Positive to increase, negative to decrease

dry_run.description: If true, simulate remediation and return impact analysis only

functions.returns: Remediation execution result including change_ticket_id, affected paths, and a status summary or dry-run impact analysis.

functions.name: rollback_remediation
functions.description: Rollback or undo a previously applied remediation change, restoring prior assurance configuration.

change_ticket_id.description: Identifier of the change/remediation to rollback

include_paths.description: Specific paths to rollback when mode=partial

validation_tests.description: Optional tests to run after rollback

functions.returns: Rollback execution status, list of reverted objects (paths, bandwidth changes, endpoint mappings), and any validation test handles.

functions.name: list_assurance_sessions
functions.description: List and filter assurance sessions for a tenant, including high-level health and SLA summary.
functions.returns: Paginated list of assurance sessions with requested summaries and basic metadata.

functions.name: pause_or_terminate_session
functions.description: Pause monitoring for cost control or terminate an assurance session and release associated resources.

retain_historical_data.description: Whether to retain telemetry and incident history after termination

effective_time.description: Optional future time to apply the operation

reason.description: Reason for pausing, resuming, or terminating

functions.returns: Updated session lifecycle state, effective time of the change, and any implications for monitoring and billing.

functions.name: bulk_import_sessions
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple sessions from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined sessions, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_sessions
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of sessions matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped sessions with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_sessions
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of sessions with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_sessions
functions.description: Export a filtered set of sessions to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_sessions_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across sessions with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with sessions hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_session_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on session lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_session_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing session subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_session_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a session subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_session_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single session with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across sessions for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_session_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of sessions.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_session_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to sessions with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of session jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_session_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight session job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_session_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a session (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_session_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive session change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_session_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a session approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_session_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a session, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_session_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a session, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_session
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a session for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_session_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a session from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_session_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over sessions (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched sessions.

functions.name: build_session_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over sessions data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_session_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern session behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_session_policies
functions.description: List policies governing sessions with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_session_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a session and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
